items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: You know people today will recognize Tchaikovsky, they’ll recognize Ellington, you know, but if you play them an Art Tatum record, they wouldn’t know what you’re talking about many times.

ctx.x: Yeah, it outlasts the players. Unfortunately, but it does. You know people today will recognize Tchaikovsky, they’ll recognize Ellington, you know, but if you play them an Art Tatum record, they wouldn’t know what you’re talking about many times. Or it could be a Dizzy.
And it’s as fresh today as it was the date that they did it. Just as fresh. Their music today is just as fresh and beautiful and inspiring — and awe inspiring rather.
